subject: SOC 2 re-attestation, evidence transfer & retention/SLA amendment
messages:
From: Aisha Shah <aisha.shah@finedge.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@finedge.com, Anita Rao <anita.rao@finedge.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 re-attestation & renewal — evidence handoff and retention change

Hi Rachel / Ben —

As we kick off our contract renewal (RWD-7421), our security team flagged two items that need to be confirmed before legal can sign off:

1) SOC 2 re-attestation timing — does Redwood plan a new report or a bridge letter for 2027?
2) Audit log retention — we are requesting 12 months of exported raw logs retained offsite for 24 months for regulatory traceability. Can Redwood support a retention SLA amendment?

Can you share an evidence index and a small sample of logs so our auditors can validate the format? If possible, wed like a short mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones and a DocuSign link for the retention amendment.

Attached is our vendor evidence checklist for reference.

Thanks,
Aisha Shah
Head of Security, FinEdge Payments
[Attachment: FinEdge-evidence-checklist.xlsx]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Shah <aisha.shah@finedge.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation & renewal — evidence handoff and retention change

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the clear ask. High-level responses and proposed next steps below: 

- SOC 2: We will provide a 2027 bridge letter + the full 2026 SOC 2 report artifacts. Our audit partner completes a full attestation in Q1 2028; the bridge letter documents control continuities for the renewal window.
- Retention SLA: We can support 12-month exported log retention with an optional 24-month offsite hold as a contract amendment. There are two implementation paths: automated daily exports to your S3, or encrypted monthly bundles delivered to a secure Drive folder.
- Evidence samples: attaching an evidence index and a small CSV sample of anonymized audit logs for format review.

Proposed MAP (draft):
1) 09/17: Delivery of evidence index and sample logs (we'll deliver today)
2) 09/20: FinEdge security review and comments
3) 09/22: DocuSign for retention amendment and capacity commit
4) 09/24: Implementation of automated export (pilot)

Ben — can you confirm the commercial note on the capacity bump we discussed (additional reserved qps for peak) so we can include that in the DocuSign amendment?

Next steps: I'll upload the evidence index to the Drive folder and share the DocuSign link once Ben confirms pricing.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0143
[Attachment: redwood-evidence-index.xlsx]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Aisha Shah <aisha.shah@finedge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, procurement@finedge.com
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation & renewal — evidence handoff and retention change

Rachel / Aisha —

Happy to confirm commercials. For the retention amendment + 12-month log export option we propose the following pricing:

- Retention amendment (12m export + optional 24m offsite): one-time fee $12,000
- Capacity bump: 2x reserved qps for 6 months (to cover their holiday peak) => committed monthly uplift $8,500/mo
- Discount: 10% on the monthly uplift if the customer signs an annual reserved commitment

If FinEdge signs the retention amendment and the 6-month capacity increase together we can include one month of complimentary reserved capacity during onboarding.

Rachel — please include these numbers in the DocuSign and call out the payment milestone tied to the amendment.

Thanks,
Ben
Director, GTM Operations
[internal comment: confirm with finance if promo credit affects next renewal]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation & renewal — implementation notes from security

Following up with a concise implementation plan from compliance, plus the requested sample.

- Retention: We will support daily exported logs in JSON/CSV. Default retention is 90 days; amendment will extend the customer export retention window to 365 days on their delivery bucket. Offsite 24-month hold will be provided as encrypted monthly bundles (SCP transfer) on request.
- Data model: audit-log-sample.csv attached; sensitive fields are redacted per our PII policy.
- Evidence index: attached (redwood-evidence-index.xlsx) with links to procedures, screenshots, and control owners.
- Controls & attestations: bridge letter drafted by compliance attached as PDF stub; final will be signed by our audit partner.

Next operational items for onboarding team:
- 09/22: Generate export pipeline credentials and update FinEdge S3 ACLs
- 09/23: Dry run export to FinEdge test bucket
- 09/24: Switch to production export and update retention policy

Please see attachments. If procurement needs the DocuSign template I can generate it; otherwise Rachel can push DocuSign once pricing is confirmed.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: audit-log-sample.csv]
[Attachment: redwood-evidence-index.xlsx]
